leakage_verification.leakage_verdict: ZERO_LEAKAGE (Train, Val, Test, and Holdout are 100% strictly partitioned)

hard_negatives.hypothesis_note: Current dataset contains 0 negative images. Lack of negative images is a leading candidate hypothesis for false positives on urban background features (utility boxes, facades, signs), to be verified experimentally in Phase 4.
